task_description.overview: Compute the Carl & Baer trigger characteristic function and detect events where the signal-to-noise ratio exceeds thresholds.
steps: Compute cft = carl_sta_trig(data, nsta, nlta, ratio, quiet).
Apply positive and negative thresholds for on/off detection.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load trace data in {waveform_data_path}. Compute Carl STA-Trig characteristic with parameters STA={STA_seconds}s, LTA={LTA_seconds}s, ratio={ratio}, quiet={quiet}. Identify on/off triggers where cft crosses {on_threshold} and {off_threshold}. Plot a figure to show the waveform, the caculated carl sta-trig result, and the finally picked onset and offset times. Save the 1D array trigger_cft series to {trigger_cft} and the plot to {trigger_plot}.
